schema_and_validation: QueryRoot, Order, CustomerJourneySummary, CustomerVisit, UTMParameters inspected; skill docs search plus CLI and connector validation passed revision1
privacy: Order IDs and exact creation/cancellation timestamps used transiently for deduplication, filtering and lifecycle checks; omitted from durable receipt. No names, email, address, order names or referrer URLs queried. Rows are arbitrary labels, not stable customer identities.
limits: First/last available journey observations only; not all intermediate moments, causal attribution or proof of complete coverage. Actual cost/profit not established. No monetary data queried absent a Pinterest match.
